title: Russian strikes kill 12 in Ukraine after Trump announces diesel deal with Putin
summary_full: A recent barrage of Russian airstrikes in Zaporizhzhia claimed at least 12 lives, including those of children. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy denounced a fresh diesel agreement forged by Donald Trump with Russia, highlighting concerns that such deals could fuel the persistent conflict in Ukraine. Zelenskyy emphasized that relaxing sanctions may encourage further military actions from Russia, underscoring the intricate and precarious nature of the current geopolitical landscape.
